cards.card_text: Solomon says the fear of the LORD lets a person rest content, without visitation from harm.
cards.verse_text: The fear of the LORD leads to life, that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.
cards.snippet: …of the LORD leads to life, that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.

cards.card_text: Then Micah speaks of the day for your watchmen, the day of your visitation.
cards.verse_text: The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation.
cards.snippet: The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation.

cards.card_text: Micah says the day of the visitation is still a long way off.
cards.verse_text: The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation.
cards.snippet: The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation.
